workarounds.symptom: stableJsonStringify throws on undefined, functions and symbols
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(json-utils): always return a string from stableJsonStringify. Target files: src/electron/utils/json-utils.ts, src/electron/utils/__tests__/json-utils.test.ts. `stableJsonStringify` assumed `JSON.stringify` always returns a string. It doesn't: So `out.length` on line 51 threw the reported `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')`. The reachable path is the Monty sandbox: `json_parse()` calls this helper whenever its argument isn't a string, including when a script passes nothing. While fixing ... (Ref: https://github.com/CoWork-OS/CoWork-OS/pull/628)
